implementation.upload: Raw image/png only; server-generated UUID and fixed branding/<uuid>.png path; complete PNG validation and metadata stripping precede upsert:false Storage upload; O03 service-role registration RPC is called only after verified user, admin role, and all parent flags are ON.
implementation.statusRead: Calls service_get_branding_asset_status before Storage reads; public GET requires published_once and not revoked, preview requires validated and not revoked; fixed path/MIME/hash/size/dimensions must match.
implementation.preview: Admin-only no-store JSON response with a same-project signed URL requested for 240 seconds; no caller JWT is placed in URL or persistent cache. The private-stack HTTP test uses the local Kong gateway authority to fetch URLs whose configured Edge origin is http://kong:8000.
implementation.publicServing: Published asset response includes a content-hash ETag and public max-age/s-maxage of 300 seconds; revocation cannot recall already-downloaded or offline copies and may propagate through existing public caches until their bounded TTL expires. Already-issued private preview URLs may remain usable until their at-most-240-second expiry.
implementation.failureCleanup: After a successful immutable Storage upload, registration failure removes only that request's generated object path. An upload error does not delete a possibly pre-existing collision path.
